notes.title: Version 0.0.0.4
notes.notes:
[b]Fixed the inability to scroll while beginning to find initial wire location. [/b]
Rotations before first selected point now also (hopefully) behave as expected.
[i][Introduced Bug 007][/i]

[b]Anti aliasing switched to FXAA. [/b]
Still investigating post processing implementations of SMAA (which UE does not support)
Other camera-radius controlled variants of MSAA too.
This will require a re-work towards a forward renderer. 
Might impact the nice flat lighting.

[b]Rotations have been modified to only WASD. [/b]
Key direction now correspond to the face they point towards.

[b]Mouse gestures have been implemented. [/b]
Holding the middle mouse button, dragging a direction, and then releasing, will rotate the cube in that direction.
Hold -> Drag up -> Release. Equivalent to pressing W.

[b]Added the ability to skip the intro video by pressing Restore -> Confirm from the main menu.[/b]

[b]Network features are disabled, and there should no longer be a firewall nag when opening the game. [/b]
